DOMMT.Dungeon.AbandonConfirm: This ends the run for good: the party is moved back out, every monster this run spawned is deleted, and the dungeon scene itself is deleted. This can't be undone.
DOMMT.Dungeon.AlreadyHostedWarning: A dungeon crawl is already in progress, hosted by {host}.
DOMMT.Dungeon.AlreadyResolvedUndoWarning: That room has already been judged — its door and any further rooms can't be undone from here.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.AgentLoopStatusNeve: Agent loop: no heartbeat ever recorded this session. Start it with node tools/agent-loop/poll.mjs if you want agent-controlled combat.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.AgentLoopStatusStal: Agent loop: not responding — last heartbeat was {seconds}s ago (provider: {provider}). It may have crashed or lost its connection; check the terminal running node tools/agent-loop/poll.mjs.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.AgentTimeoutChat: {name}'s turn was agent-controlled, but nothing responded in time. Falling back to the default combat AI for this turn.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.AgentTimeoutChatDis: {name}'s turn was agent-controlled, but the agent-loop poller doesn't appear to be connected (no recent heartbeat). Falling back to the default combat AI for this turn — start node tools/agent-loop/poll.mjs if you want the AI back.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.AgentTimeoutWarning: {name}'s agent-controlled turn timed out — falling back to the default AI.
{name}'s agent-controlled turn timed out — the agent-loop poller doesn't appear to be running. Falling back to the default AI.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.InProgressHint: Combat is underway — the party can't move on until it's resolved.
DOMMT.Dungeon.Combat.ReactiveStrikeChat: {name} reacts with a Reactive Strike against {target}!
DOMMT.Dungeon.DoorLockedHint: The way forward is locked until the next room is populated.
